name: Meilisearch
summary: Open-source search and AI retrieval engine with a managed cloud: full-text, vector and hybrid search, and a free self-hosted option.
description: Open-source search and AI retrieval engine with a managed cloud: full-text, vector and hybrid search, and a free self-hosted option.

pricing.details: Self-hosting the open-source engine is free. Meilisearch Cloud starts at 18 €/month, with a 14-day free trial and no credit card required (official starting price; the on-page estimator shows instance sizes and a regional disk component that vary by region — those line items were not copied in full and are left to the official calculator). Enterprise is custom (dedicated resources, up to 99.999% uptime SLA, Slack support, SSO, SOC 2).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Open-source search and AI retrieval: full-text, vector and hybrid search
Free self-hosting, or a managed Cloud with a fixed monthly instance price regardless of search volume
9 hosting regions, unlimited team members, no per-seat fees
Cloud officially starts at 18 €/month after a 14-day trial; the instance/region estimator is not copied in full
